a117.note: 面板尺度的形變不能直接套用晶圓補償。晶圓照片只供圓形基材與尺度比較，不是面板級封裝製程的實拍。 辨認晶粒排列；色彩不等於特定膜厚或製程節點。

a044.noteEn: The research ALD system supports the conformal-spacer concept used in quadruple patterning. It shows neither a quadrupled line pattern nor measured pitch control or defect performance.

a072.note: ALD 是 3D NAND 高深寬比薄膜研究的相關製程；這是通用研究設備，不是 NAND 堆疊截面或記憶孔實拍。

a076.noteEn: The ALD tool supports the concept of controlled oxide-film deposition. It does not show resistive switching, conductive filaments or ReRAM endurance measurements.

a090.note: ALD 研究設備提供薄膜成長的比較背景；不是大面積顯示面板產線或 TFT 背板實拍，也不能直接套用晶圓設備的均勻性。

titleEn: X-57 cruise motor controller vibration test
author: NASA/Ken Ulbrich
sourceDescription: A cruise motor controller for the X-57 Maxwell, NASA's first all-electric X-plane, undergoes vibration testing at NASA Armstrong Flight Research Center's environmental lab. title: 風扇聲學機匣處理試驗
author: Marvin Smith
sourceDescription: Title: W-8 Fan Acoustic Casing Treatment Test on the Source Diagnostic Test Rotor Alone Hardware Program: Advanced Air Vehicles Program (AAVP) Project: Advanced Air Transport Technology (AATT) Sub-project: Aircraft Noise Reduction (ANR)   Weekly Highlight: ·         Acoustic Casing Treatment Testing Completed in the W-8 Single Stage Axial Compressor Facility: Testing of Acoustic Casing Treatments on the Source Diagnostic Test (SDT) rotor alone hardware which had begun in early January was completed on Thursday, February 16th. Four different over-the-rotor acoustic casing treatment concepts were tested along with two baseline configurations. Testing included steady-aerodynamic measurements of fan performance, hotfilm turbulence measurements, and inlet acoustic measurements with an in-duct array. These measurements will be used to assess the aerodynamic and acoustic impact of fan acoustic casing treatments on a high bypass ratio fan at TRL 3. This test was the last of 3 planned tests of potential over-the-rotor acoustic casing treatments. The first treatment test was completed in the Normal Incidence Tube (NIT) at Langley Research Center (LaRC) in Fall 2015 and the second was completed on the Advanced Noise Control Fan (ANCF) in the Aero-Acoustic Propulsion Laboratory (AAPL) in Winter 2016. This work is supported by the Aircraft Noise Reduction (ANR) subproject of the Advanced Air Transport Technology (AATT) Project. (POC: LTV/ Rick Bozak 3-5160)

title: 研究機光纖感測器地面驗證
author: NASA/Tony Landis
sourceDescription: NASA engineer Larry Hudson and Ikhana ground crew member James Smith work on a ground validation test with new fiber optic sensors that led to validation flights on the Ikhana aircraft. NASA Dryden Flight Research Center is evaluating an advanced fiber optic-based sensing technology installed on the wings of NASA's Ikhana aircraft. The fiber optic system measures and displays the shape of the aircraft's wings in flight. There are other potential safety applications for the technology, such as vehicle structural health monitoring. If an aircraft structure can be monitored with sensors and a computer can manipulate flight control surfaces to compensate for stresses on the wings, structural control can be established to prevent situations that might otherwise result in a loss of control.

photoHotspots.title: 綠色閥門手輪
photoHotspots.text: 可見手輪、閥桿方向及其連接管路。先沿管路追蹤上下游，再討論閥門如何影響阻力；照片不提供閥位、流體種類或允許操作順序。
photoHotspots.textEn: Identify the handwheel, stem direction and connected piping. Trace upstream and downstream before discussing flow resistance. The image does not specify valve position, fluid identity or an authorized operating sequence.

photoHotspots.title: 螺栓固定的管件蓋板
photoHotspots.text: 綠色圓形蓋板周圍有多個螺栓，位於直立管件上。觀察接合面與可拆卸結構；不能由外觀判定內部構造、墊片材質或是否已隔離壓力。
photoHotspots.textEn: A green circular cover with several bolts sits on the vertical fitting. Observe the joint and removable construction. Internal geometry, gasket material and pressure isolation cannot be determined from appearance.

photoHotspots.title: 下方泵浦與馬達組
photoHotspots.text: 底部可見藍色泵殼連著黑色馬達，兩者固定在共同底座上。把電力輸入、軸功率與流體輸出畫成能量路徑；流量和揚程仍需量測資料。
photoHotspots.textEn: A blue pump housing connects to a black motor on a shared base. Sketch the path from electrical input through shaft power to fluid output. Flow and head still require measurement data.

photoHotspots.title: 中央黃色機組外殼
photoHotspots.text: 中央機組的黃色外殼、固定支承及周圍通道可清楚辨認。先描述可見配置，再查原廠資料辨識內部部件；外觀不足以推定功率、效率或維修狀態。
photoHotspots.textEn: The central yellow housing, supports and surrounding access space are visible. Describe the layout before consulting manufacturer documentation for internal parts. Appearance alone does not establish power, efficiency or maintenance condition.

photoHotspots.title: 上方纜線束與支承
photoHotspots.text: 多條粗纜線從上方支承區彎向機組。觀察纜線路徑與機械通道的分隔，思考電氣、結構和維修空間如何協調；照片不能用來判定電壓或載流量。
photoHotspots.textEn: Several thick cables curve from overhead supports toward the machinery. Observe separation between cable routing and access space. Electrical, structural and maintenance needs share this area; voltage and ampacity cannot be inferred from the photo.

photoHotspots.title: 柱旁圓形指示錶
photoHotspots.text: 白色柱旁可見紅框圓形指示錶。先辨認錶面、指針和安裝位置；這張影像不足以可靠讀出單位或數值，因此不要將它填入教學算例作為實測輸入。
photoHotspots.textEn: A red-rimmed round dial is mounted beside the white column. Locate its face, pointer and mounting position. Units and readings are not sufficiently clear here, so do not enter a guessed value as a measured input.

photoHotspots.title: 水下影像顯示幕
photoHotspots.text: 大型螢幕顯示照明下的水下景象。先區分影像中的物件、相機視角及畫面外未知區域；單張照片不能提供當前深度、距離或可通行範圍。
photoHotspots.textEn: The large monitor shows an illuminated underwater view. Separate visible objects, camera viewpoint and unseen areas. A photograph does not provide current depth, range or traversable clearance.

photoHotspots.title: 狀態資料顯示幕
photoHotspots.text: 下排螢幕同時有數字、方向圖與欄位。練習先找出各欄位的名稱、單位及時間，再討論它們與影像是否同步；不要把照片上的舊數字當作即時遙測。
photoHotspots.textEn: The lower display combines numbers, direction graphics and fields. Identify labels, units and timestamps before comparing them with video. Numbers captured in the photo are not live telemetry.

photoHotspots.title: 發光按鍵操作區
photoHotspots.text: 螢幕下方可見多排發光按鍵。把實體輸入、軟體命令與畫面回饋畫成流程圖；照片無法確定每一個按鍵的實際功能，點此熱點只開啟說明。
photoHotspots.textEn: Rows of illuminated controls are visible below the monitor. Draw the relationship between physical input, software command and displayed feedback. Individual button functions cannot be established from the image; this hotspot only opens an explanation.

hotspotAnnotationMethod: Coordinates selected after visual inspection of each complete delivery photograph; explanatory overlays, not automatic instrument recognition, sensor readings or image-pixel edits.

photoHotspots.title: 左側測繪資料視窗
photoHotspots.text: 左螢幕可見彩色條帶和矩形選取框。先說明選取範圍與資料顯示的差別，再討論品質檢查；這張照片沒有提供可下載的原始聲納紀錄。
photoHotspots.textEn: The left monitor shows a colored strip and rectangular selection boxes. Distinguish a selected region from the underlying data display before discussing quality control. This photo supplies no raw sonar record.

photoHotspots.title: 右側彩色測深點雲
photoHotspots.text: 右螢幕顯示由許多彩色點構成的海床形貌。顏色需要搭配圖例和座標系解讀；不能單憑截圖將某一顏色換算成深度或斷定離群點必須刪除。
photoHotspots.textEn: The right monitor displays seabed form as many colored points. Interpret color with its legend and coordinate system. A screenshot alone cannot convert color to depth or justify deleting an apparent outlier.

photoHotspots.title: 資料編輯鍵盤
photoHotspots.text: 桌面鍵盤與滑鼠是資料檢視和標註的輸入設備。課內練習應保留原始資料、處理紀錄及回復方法，再比較處理前後；這個熱點不會操作照片中的工作站。
photoHotspots.textEn: The keyboard and mouse provide input for viewing and annotating data. Preserve raw data, processing history and a way to revert before comparing results. This hotspot does not control the pictured workstation.

photoHotspots.title: 直列類比指示錶
photoHotspots.text: 上方直列錶面搭配設備名稱與量測項目標籤。先逐一辨認量測項目與單位，避免把溫度、壓力及轉速混用；照片上的讀值不作為當前船況。
photoHotspots.textEn: The upper vertical indicators have equipment and measurement labels. Identify each quantity and unit before comparing temperature, pressure or speed. Their photographed readings do not represent the vessel’s current condition.

photoHotspots.title: 機艙車鐘刻度盤
photoHotspots.text: 下方圓盤可見STOP、SLOW等分段文字，用來表達車令等級。比較離散命令與實際量測值的差別；車令標示不是螺槳轉速或航速的直接讀值。
photoHotspots.textEn: The lower dial has discrete labels such as STOP and SLOW for engine orders. Compare discrete commands with measured responses. An order label is not a direct propeller-speed or vessel-speed measurement.

photoHotspots.title: 右側操縱桿
photoHotspots.text: 右側可見黑色握柄與金屬行程槽。觀察操作輸入的機械形式，將它與上方指示錶的回饋分開；照片未確認此操縱桿的聯鎖、有效控制站或實際功能。
photoHotspots.textEn: A black handle sits in a metal travel slot on the right. Separate this mechanical input from indicator feedback above. Interlocks, the active control station and the lever’s exact function are not established by the photo.

photoHotspots.title: 環列採水瓶
photoHotspots.text: 前方編號9的長筒是環列採水瓶之一。沿著瓶身找出上、下端及支架；採水瓶保存水樣，不能把瓶身直接當作溫度或鹽度探頭。照片沒有提供水樣深度或分析結果。
photoHotspots.textEn: The numbered cylinder at the front is one of the rosette sampling bottles. Trace its body, ends and supports. A bottle retains a water sample; it is not itself a temperature or salinity probe. This image provides no sample depth or analysis result.

photoHotspots.title: 頂部吊掛連接
photoHotspots.text: 可見鋼索連到裝置頂部金屬吊掛構件。先沿受力路徑找出吊索、連接點與外框，再把它們與資料纜線區分。照片不能證明吊具額定能力或當前檢查狀態。
photoHotspots.textEn: The cable meets a metal lifting connection above the rosette. Trace the visible lifting path and distinguish it from data wiring. The photograph does not establish lifting capacity or inspection status.

photoHotspots.title: 白色環形保護框
photoHotspots.text: 白色環形外框包圍採水瓶與底部裝置。觀察它與船舷及甲板的相對位置，理解回收空間為何需要事先規劃；這是觀察任務，不提供真實吊放指令。
photoHotspots.textEn: The white circular frame surrounds the bottles and lower equipment. Observe its position relative to the deck and ship side to understand why recovery space is planned. This observation task provides no real deployment commands.

hotspotAnnotationMethod: Coordinates selected after visual inspection of each complete delivery photograph; explanatory overlays, not automatic instrument recognition, sensor readings or image-pixel edits.

photoHotspots.title: 水中的白色船模
photoHotspots.titleEn: White hull model in the water
photoHotspots.text: 觀察船模輪廓、水線附近和水面反射。這是縮尺船模的實拍；若要比較模型與實船，還需知道尺度、吃水、速度及相似條件，不能只按照片長度換算阻力。
photoHotspots.textEn: Observe the model outline, waterline region and reflection. Comparing model and full-scale vessel requires scale, draft, speed and similarity assumptions. Resistance cannot be obtained by scaling image lengths.

photoHotspots.title: 船模上方垂直連接件
photoHotspots.text: 船模上方可見垂直連接構件連到上方裝置。追蹤幾何連接關係，將支承／拖曳結構和實際力感測器區分；照片不足以確認感測器型式或校正係數。
photoHotspots.textEn: A vertical member connects the model to the apparatus above. Trace the geometry while distinguishing supports or tow connections from a force sensor. Sensor type and calibration are not established by this photograph.

photoHotspots.title: 水槽上方紅色橫架
photoHotspots.text: 紅色橫架跨在水槽上方。把船模、水槽和上方拖曳構架放入同一系統圖，討論定速區段為何重要；此靜態影像沒有提供拖車速度或試驗時序。
photoHotspots.textEn: The red structure spans above the tank. Place model, tank and towing structure in a system diagram and explain the need for a steady-speed segment. This still image provides neither carriage speed nor a test timeline.

hotspotAnnotationMethod: Coordinates selected after visual inspection of each complete delivery photograph; explanatory overlays, not automatic instrument recognition, sensor readings or image-pixel edits.

c151.note: Newcastle及UCL實拍為不同學校的船模／拖曳水槽；USGS實拍為流速儀器校準水槽，不是同一場實驗，也不能由照片取得阻力數據。
c151.noteEn: Newcastle and UCL photographs show separate model/towing laboratories; USGS shows a water-velocity instrument calibration tank. They do not document one shared experiment or supply resistance measurements.

photoHotspots.title: 水槽自由液面
photoHotspots.text: 中央水面反射上方鋼架，讓實體與倒影容易混淆。先辨認自由液面，再討論造波、反射和水槽邊界如何影響模型試驗；照片沒有顯示可量測的波高序列。
photoHotspots.textEn: The water reflects the overhead frame, making objects and reflections easy to confuse. Locate the free surface before discussing waves, reflections and tank boundaries. No measurable wave-height time series is provided.

photoHotspots.title: 透明側壁與邊框
photoHotspots.text: 透明側壁及其上緣沿水槽延伸。觀察可視範圍及側壁位置，思考有限水槽寬度與深度如何限制試驗；影像透視不能代替校準尺寸。
photoHotspots.textEn: The transparent sidewall and rim extend along the tank. Observe visibility and boundaries when considering finite width and depth. Image perspective does not replace calibrated dimensions.

photoHotspots.title: 跨槽鋼構支承
photoHotspots.text: 深色鋼梁橫跨水槽，上方與側邊還有其他支承構件。將固定結構、可能移動的試驗裝置及水域分層標示；單張照片無法確認所有構件的運動自由度。
photoHotspots.textEn: A dark steel beam spans the tank with additional supports above and alongside. Distinguish fixed structure, test apparatus and water. A single photograph cannot establish every component’s degrees of freedom.

hotspotAnnotationMethod: Coordinates selected after visual inspection of each complete delivery photograph; explanatory overlays, not automatic instrument recognition, sensor readings or image-pixel edits.
